name: Recall Ready Building Product Service Campaigns
description: Comprehensive guide for building product service campaigns using actionable lists and data processing engine. Learn to create targeted campaigns for asset recalls, warranty notifications, and proactive service outreach.
industry_features: Batch Management;Complaints Management;Timeline;Record Alerts;Audit Trail;Actionable Segmentation;Action Plans;Data Processing Engine

sections.title: Actionable List Configuration Guide
steps: Guided steps to create Actionable lists powered by data processing engine to create Asset or Vehicle data sets
1. 1. Click the Gear 2. Click on Setup…
Access setup from any page in your org
2. 1. In setup quick search Type "Actionable" 2. Click Actionable Segmentation Settings
3. 1.Click on New Data Processing Engine Definition
Data processing engine is an industry provided platform data transformation and aggregation component.
4. 1. Type "WorkshopAssetServiceEOLUpgradeCampaign" 2. Pick Asset from the object list 3. Click on Save & Next
5. Click on Launch Data Processing Engine

sections.title: Data Processing Engine Configuration
steps: Configure the new context definition for Assets
6. 1. Click the Asset_DS Data Source 2 .Click on Configure
7.1. Click on Selected Fields (2) button
Here we will choose all the fields for asset that we may want to use for the campaign and other nodes like a join
8. 1. Select the fields from Asset as shown 2. Update the alias names where shown 3. Click Save
9. 1. Click on Save for the Asset node
10. Click on New Node
11. 1. Choose Data Source for Node Type 2. Type AssetWarranty_DS in Name field 3. Click in the API Name field to auto populate the API Name 4.Click on Save
12. 1. Type "Asset Wa" and select Asset Warranty Entity form source object field
13. Click on Select Fields of Asset warranty
Here we will choose all the fields we may want to use from Asset Warranty entity in the data set.
14. 1. Select the fields from asset warranty object as shown 2. Update the alias names where shown 3. Click Save
15. 1. Click on Add Related Object from the Asset Warranty Configuration page
16. 1. Click on Related Object
17. 1. Click on Add Related Object button from the Asset Warranty Configuration page 2. Choose Asset from the related object field 3. Click the Select fields button
Here we chose related fields from asset within Asset Warranty
18. 1. Select the field from asset related object as shown 2. Update the alias names where shown 3. Click Save
19. Click on Save again to save the Asset Warranty Node
20. 1. Click on New Node
In the next few steps we will join the two data source nodes together
21. 1. Choose Join for Node Type 2. Type "Join Asset to Asset Warranty" in Name field 3. Click in the API Name field to auto populate the API Name 4. Click on Save
22. 1. In the first node choose Asset_DS 2. In the second node choose Asset Warranty _DS
Here we actual perform the join for the two selected objects
23. 1. Click on Select Fields button next to the source node Asset_DS
24. 1, Check Select All checkbox 2. Click Save
25. 1.Click on Select Fields button next to the Asset Warranty _DS source node
26. 1. Check Select All checkbox 2. Click Save
27. Click on First Node Field
28. 1. In the mapped fields section select Asset_DS_id from First Node Field 2. Select AssetId_AW_DS from the Second Node Field 3. Click Save
29. 1.Click on New Node
30. 1. In Node Type select Writeback Object 2.In Name Type "Asset Warranty EOL Campaign WriteBack" 3. Click the API Name to auto populate the API Name 4. Click Save

31. 1. In the source node within the writeback configuration, choose Join Asset to Asset Warranty join node 2. Select the radio button for Analytics in Target Type 3. Type "WorkshopAssetServiceEOLUpgradeCampaign" into Dataset Name field
32. 1. In the Field Mapping section select all the fields adding rows as needed
🛑In this sections simply click each field in the drop down and click the add button until all fields are used
33. 1. At the bottom for Field Mappings choose Folder Name ActionableSegmentation 2. Click Save
34. 1.Click on Save on the Top right to save the Data processing engine definition 2. Click Activate
35. 1. Click on Run Definition
36. 1. Click Next through the wizard accepting defaults
This completes the data processing engine portion to build out the dataset

sections.title: Advanced Data Processing Configuration
steps: 37. 1. Click Setup gear 2. In setup quick search Type "Actionable" 3. Click Actionable Segmentation Settings
Navigate Back to the Actionable Segmentation Settings
38. 1. Click on Refresh Dataset Status
39. 1. In the workshop actionable list Click on + Add Columns
40. 1. Click the available field names and move them all to the selected field name box 2.Click on Save
41. 1. Click on + Add Statuses
42. 1. Click New Status button and add the shown status items 2. Click save
After complete the actionable list , these are the status actions that will be available
43. 1. Toggle on to activate
44. 1.Click on OK
45. 1. Click the App Launcher icon 2. In search Type "Actionable List" 3. Click Actionable List

sections.title: Actionable List Creation
steps: 46. Click on New to create a new actionable list
47. 1.Type Workshop Upgrade Campaign in the New Actionable List Name 2. Select the Data processing Engine definition create earlier WorkshopAssetServiceEOLUpgradeCampaign 3. Click Next
48. 1.Click the Filter Criteria 2.Choose InstallDate… 3. Choose Previous Fiscal Year 4. Click Apply
49. 1.Check Select All to select all the filtered assets
50. 1. Click on Review & Save (55)
51. 1. Click on Confirm & Save

sections.title: Product Service Campaign Configuration
steps: 52. 1. From App Launcher search for Product Service Campaigns 2. Click New
Now We create a new product service campaign and connect the actionable list

53. 1. Type "Workshop Upgrade Campaign for the Campaign Name 2. Select Upgrade from the type pick list 3. Select a work type "replace compressor" 4. In Start date choose "Today" 5. In the actionable list choose WorkShop Upgrade Campaign 6. Click Save
In this section we are connecting the campaign to the actionable list to foster integration between data sets and campaigns.
54. 1. Click the actionable list link to take you back to the Workshop Upgrade Campaign actionable list
55. 1. Click the action carrot 2. Click on Add to Service Campaign
Performing this function will automatically add all the assets to the campaign.
56. Click on Confirm
57. Success - Assets are added
Note you may get an error here on redirect to the previous product campaign but the items are added as this org is not Generally available. This is related to the demo env itself.
58. 1. Navigate back to the Product Service Campaign from App Launcher 2. Click on Related 3. Verify the Assets are added
59. 1. Click the action carrot and Select "create work order for all items" 2. Click confirm button
The Final Step is to create work order in mass to support the cross-sell upsell efforts and get techs onsite. The great news is this is done is mass again for all assets added to the campaign
60. 1. Verify created work orders
